scope: Lightweight application of migration0031 and actual PostgreSQL guard introspection on the owned source and the already-restored target. No new restore or model inference.
coordinator_release: Quality cycle3 final build/gates confirmed exit0 before any lifecycle action; no overlap with the source lifecycle lock.

commands.command: Start only exact owned PostgreSQL, capture pre-migration business metadata
Owned compose manage manage migrate --noinput using pinned final image, with no application workers
Real model/byte comparisons and pg_get_functiondef/pg_get_triggerdef introspection

triggers: CREATE TRIGGER garimpei_gold_authorization BEFORE INSERT ON public.runtime_alertattempt FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION garimpei_gold_authorization_guard()
required_failclosed_fragments_checked: FROM runtime_assistancepolicy WHERE id=1 AND active
expected_policy = 'assisted-evidence-v1' AND adopted IS DISTINCT FROM 'active'
IF permitted IS DISTINCT FROM true

limits: This verifies deployment of the already-reviewed/tested guard and preserves the existing business evidence. It does not replace the separate controlled positive/negative authorization tests.
No independent human corpus or real-positive F21 acceptance is inferred.
All prior runtime and restore proofs are historical and remain unmodified.
